_pressure_envelope.note: timeOfOpening and timeClosed are NAIVE — no `Z` suffix, no `+00:00` offset. The K-Series doc says order timestamps are UTC instants always with `Z`; per `docs/integrations/lightspeed_lsk/field_mapping.md` Timestamp shapes, the framework's vendor_timestamp_policy.lightspeed_lsk.asUtc declares ambiguous parses must NOT silently coerce — they MUST be rejected.
